view.scene_description: A brightly lit convenience store aisle with refrigerated and open shelves stocked with beverages, snacks, and packaged goods. Decorative hot air balloon lights hang from the ceiling. The left wall features red branding with Chinese characters. The floor is reflective, and the layout suggests a typical retail environment.

objects.label: refrigerated display case
objects.observation: Long glass-fronted unit on the left, filled with bottled drinks and dairy products. Shelves inside are well-stocked. It runs along the aisle and reflects overhead lighting. No visible support structure from this angle.

objects.label: hot air balloon decoration
objects.observation: Blue-and-white striped balloon suspended from ceiling near center-right. Appears to float above the aisle. Made of fabric, with visible strings or wires attaching it to the ceiling. Not obscured by other objects.

objects.label: shelf with packaged snacks
objects.observation: Metal shelving unit on the right side, holding bags of chips and other snacks. Items are arranged neatly. The shelf is supported by a metal frame visible at its base. Partially occludes items behind it.

objects.label: bottled beverages
objects.observation: Rows of plastic bottles with red caps on lower shelves of the right-side unit. Bottles are upright and tightly packed. They rest directly on the shelf surface. No visible supports beyond the shelf itself.

objects.label: ceiling lights
objects.observation: Fluorescent light fixtures mounted to the black ceiling, illuminating the aisle. Positioned above the shelves and decorations. Emit bright white light. No visible supports from this angle.

objects.label: wall signage
objects.observation: Red banner with white Chinese characters running along the upper left wall. Text includes phrases like '就要可口可乐' (Just Coca-Cola). Mounted flush to the wall, partially obscuring the top of the refrigerated unit.

prompts.native_chat_prompt_text:
<|im_start|>system
You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "thud_dense_test50/image-000001", "image_size": [960, 540], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
